descriptionChirho: A tall fortified structure used for defense, watchkeeping, or as part of city walls and fortifications.
The word migdal used as part of a proper place name such as Migdal-Eder (Tower of the Flock), Migdal-Gad, or Migdal-El.
A raised wooden platform or podium constructed for public reading or speaking, as in Nehemiah 8:4.
